statement: Under the source master crossing-rank and recurrence hypotheses, polynomial-workspace root and factor evaluators, and a polynomially generated good-prime inventory, the fixed-density clause-network counting route has the source n/(log n)^alpha time envelope and polynomial workspace including sequential CRT.
